subject: Re: MAP & stakeholder map - next steps and procurement timing
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.p@finpay.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@finpay.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + procurement process at FinPay

Hi Marissa

Thanks for the intro call today. Quick recap from my side: FinPay is evaluating a hosted inference partner to reduce per-token costs and get better latency for our transaction anomaly detector. Key concerns: SOC2 evidence, data residency, and procurement timing (quarter-end budget).

Next steps we discussed:
- You to share a draft MAP with milestones and security contacts.
- I'll confirm who the economic buyer is (likely Olivia) and introduce procurement.
- We'll try to get a procurement timeline by the end of June.

Attaching the stakeholder map you mentioned would be helpful. Can you also include a high-level cost estimate for the configuration we covered (dedicated capacity + 99th p99 latency SLA)?

Thanks 
Samir
Head of Infrastructure
FinPay

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.p@finpay.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + procurement process at FinPay

Samir 

Great to meet you on Monday - thanks for the clear priorities. I'm attaching a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a simple stakeholder map PDF so you can share with Olivia and procurement. High-level cost estimate included on tab 2 of the MAP (conservative reserved capacity + burst).

Quick highlights / proposed milestones (from the MAP):
1) Discovery follow-up & stakeholder confirmation - by 6/22 (owner: FinPay)
2) Security questionnaire & SOC2 evidence exchange - by 6/26 (owner: Redwood / FinPay)
3) Procurement/contract review - by 6/30 (owner: FinPay procurement)
4) Pilot kickoff (2-week pilot) - target 7/15 (owner: FinPay + Redwood)

Camila (cc) will be the technical lead from our side for the pilot. If you confirm Olivia as the economic buyer, I'll loop in our sales director for approvals and any discount conversation.

Attachments: FinPay-MAP-v1.2.xlsx (xlsx), FinPay-stakeholder-map.pdf (pdf)

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@finpay.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <samir.p@finpay.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@finpay.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP & stakeholder map - next steps and procurement timing

Thanks Marissa 

I've reviewed the MAP and cost tab. A few clarifications: 
- Security: procurement will need SOC2 Type II and a short data flow diagram for our legal/security review. Do you have a standard package?
- Procurement timeline: procurement is out of office the week of 6/29, so realistically they'll review contracts the week of 7/6. Can we move the contract review milestone to 7/10?
- Decision criteria: performance (p99 <= 300ms), data controls (VPC option), and unit cost < $0.003/token for our steady-state volume. Those will be weighted equally.

I can confirm I'm the economic buyer but procurement will own the contract terms. Planning to introduce the procurement lead next week.

Olivia
CFO (acting)
FinPay

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@finpay.com>, Samir Patel <samir.p@finpay.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 08:23:00 -0700

Olivia 
 thanks for the clarity and the decision criteria. Updated proposal below and a couple of asks so we can adjust the MAP before procurement sees it:

Updated milestones (proposed):
- Security evidence pack & data flow diagram shared (Redwood) - target 7/2
- Procurement initial review - target 7/10 (FinPay procurement)
- Contract redlines returned - target 7/17
- Pilot start - 7/24

Action items for FinPay:
1) Confirm procurement contact + introduction (Samir)
2) Confirm the pilot scope (desired datasets, QPS targets) - owner: Olivia

Camila - can you prepare the SOC2 evidence pack and a one-page data flow diagram? Dylan, can you confirm pricing sensitivity if we need a 30-day pilot with reserved capacity?

I'll update the MAP and re-upload to Drive once Camila sends the evidence pack.

Thanks 
Marissa

Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP & stakeholder map - next steps and procurement timing

All 

quick update from the security/technical side. Attached is the SOC2 summary and the one-page data flow diagram. I also added a short note on VPC options and key management.

What I sent:
- SOC2-summary.pdf (contains controls list and our auditor contact)
- FinPay-data-flow-1p.pdf

Notes:
- SOC2 Type II report is available under NDA; I've included the summary now to speed procurement. Please let me know procurement contact so we can start the NDA.
- For the pilot, we recommend a dedicated small pool (2x A100 equiv) to get consistent p99 performance - Dylan, we flagged pricing in the MAP tab and included a burst buffer for peak windows.

Next: Marissa will update the MAP with these timestamps and upload the new MAP (v1.3) to the Drive link. Samir/Olivia - once procurement contact is introduced, we'll send the SOC2 under NDA and schedule procurement Q&A.

Camila Reyes
